newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo float led by Zandano and Merlini.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo float led by Zandano and Merlini.

text.p: The board of the foundation that controls Italy's largest commercial bank San Paolo di Torino said on Tuesday it would entrust the bank's privatisation to the chairmen of the foundation and the bank.

The foundation's chairman Gianni Merlini and the bank's chairman Gianni Zandano will lead the management of the bank towards privatisation, the foundation said in a statement. Currently, the foundation owns around 65 percent of the bank.

Merlini and Zandano will be entrusted with the creation of a stable nucleus of shareholders holding around 20 percent of the bank's shares, and also with a public offer for a further 25 percent of shares in the bank.
San Paolo had outlined its privatisation plans in late February when the company announced its 1996 results.
